text:
Ava Chen: Quick poll — should we hang the big mistletoe over the lobby couch again this year? :christmas_tree: :thinking_face:
Diego Ramos: yes pls, last year's photos were elite :joy:
Maya Patel: I'm torn. Cute but also a hazard if people start doing group pics between the couches :sweat_smile:
Samir: I vote no unless we put a sign that says 'no surprise smooches' :grimacing:
Lina K.: Can we compromise and do a tiny one on the string lights instead? less droppy? :sparkles:
Ava Chen: @Lina K. that could work. also, ops — any restrictions from facilities?
office-ops-bot: Reminder: Decorations must not be attached with nails or create trip hazards. Please use only approved clips/zip ties.
Diego Ramos: we used `zip-ties` last time and taped the ends. looked fine.
Maya Patel: pic from last year if anyone forgot: img_2024_mistletoe.jpg :camera_with_flash:
Samir: lol that one with @Diego Ramos and the giant foam santa is forever iconic :rofl:
Lina K.: Also, tiny poll — would people rather: (A) Giant mistletoe over couch, (B) Mini mistletoe on string lights, (C) No mistletoe but a holiday card wall? Reply A/B/C
Ava Chen: I'll tally at 2pm and order clips if we go with A/B.
Diego Ramos: A
Maya Patel: B
Samir: C (but I promise to still photobomb)
Lina K.: B
Ava Chen: Current tally: A=1, B=2, C=1. Still time to change your vote! :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Maya Patel: if B wins, can we also add a tiny string of battery LEDs? so instagram lighting is nice :heart_eyes:
office-ops-bot: Ops note: Decorations in common areas must be removed by Jan 8.
Ava Chen: Noted. Thanks team — looks like B will win. I'll put up a volunteer sign-up in #lunch-plans for a 4:30 hang-and-decor slot today.
Diego Ramos: I can help hang LEDs and untangle lights lol
Samir: I'll bring hot cocoa sachets for the crew :mug_with_hot_cream:
Maya Patel: yay festive! :tada:
